note: GROUNDWORK PLATFORM DEFAULT — applies to every tenant unless that tenant has its own override (see finance_config_override / /finance/config). Not specific to any one customer. Every rule marked "placeholder": true is a generic contractor/landscaping/service-business starter example, not a confirmed business rule for any real company — see BLOCKED-W5-classifier.md. Edit this file to change the platform-wide default; a tenant editing /finance/config changes only that tenant's own override, never this file. Patterns are JS regex source strings (case-insensitive, applied to vendor name for stage 1 and memo/description for stage 2). Deliberately conservative: nothing new here resolves at "high" confidence, so new categories still route to review until real data confirms them.

stage3_amount_review_rules.reason: amount exceeds $5,000 — always review regardless of match confidence

confidence_thresholds.note: A stage 1/2 match at or above auto_categorize_min resolves deterministically (writes classification_finding, no human review needed) unless it also hits a forced_review_categories entry or a stage3 amount rule. Anything below that threshold, or with no match at all, becomes a review action_item(verb='decide') — the AI stage's suggestion (if enabled) is attached to that review item as a suggestion only, never auto-applied (CLAUDE.md: never auto-post on model self-reported confidence alone). stage4_fallback_min is the floor below which the AI's suggestion isn't even attached — too low-confidence to be useful context for the reviewer.
